title: Reconfigurable & Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces
text: RIS, STAR-RIS and stacked intelligent metasurfaces (SIM) for wave-domain beamforming, optimized jointly with the base-station transceiver.

title: Multi-Antenna Systems & Multiple Access
text: MIMO and MIMO-OFDM transceiver design and interference management with rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA), under sum-rate and max-min fairness objectives.

title: Optimization for Wireless Networks
text: Convex and non-convex optimization for resource allocation: successive convex approximation, block-coordinate gradient methods, and practical constraints such as amplifier nonlinearity.

title: 5G/6G Physical Layer & URLLC
text: 3GPP-compliant link- and system-level modeling: 5G NR HARQ, configured-grant access, and latency analysis for safety-critical industrial IoT.

title: Integrated Sensing & Communication
text: Joint beamforming that lets one network sense its environment while serving its users, with beampattern constraints alongside rate objectives.

title: Deep Learning for Wireless
text: Learning-based tools where they help the physical layer: uncertainty-aware continual learning for channel prediction in non-stationary channels, and generative AI for 6G.
